SELECT 
    p.patkey AS patient_id,
    a.abkey AS assessment_id,
    e.timemark AS most_recent_assessment_date,
    ROUND(AVG(asd.strslvl)) AS average_rounded_TES_score,
    f.envstress AS site_stress_indicator
FROM 
    patients p
JOIN 
    encounters e ON p.patkey = e.patref
JOIN 
    assessmentbasics a ON e.abref = a.abkey
JOIN 
    assessmentsocialanddiagnosis asd ON a.abkey = asd.asdkey
JOIN 
    facilities f ON e.facid = f.fackey
JOIN 
    treatmentbasics tb ON e.enckey = tb.encref
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT 
        patref, 
        MAX(timemark) as max_date
    FROM 
        encounters
    GROUP BY 
        patref
) recent ON e.patref = recent.patref AND e.timemark = recent.max_date
WHERE 
    f.envstress = 'High'
    AND tb.therapy_details->>'engagement' = 'Weak'
GROUP BY 
    p.patkey, a.abkey, e.timemark, f.envstress
ORDER BY 
    e.timemark DESC
LIMIT 10;
